description: This source file defines a GatewayPushSubscription enum with static methods for consuming push notifications and restarting related tasks, using async/await patterns and MainActor annotations.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes to a push stream, processes each push with a provided handler, and handles task cancellation.

methods.name: restartTask
methods.description: Cancels an existing task and starts a new one to consume push notifications with specified buffering.
